{{Quote|Here's your chance to beat up some helpless opponents. It's not that much of a contest.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wex Dafid]] briefs recruits before recreating Dev's mission|<ref name="XWOSG" />}}
The '''raid in the Senex system''' occurred early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During a [[The Maze (pilot proving ground)|training]] mission, [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Dev]] accidentally entered in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training ground in the [[Senex system/Legends|Senex system]]. Mistaking Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] for exercise targets, he wiped them out before he understood he was in Imperial space.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the first X-wing historical mission: "Dev's Sidestep".
